name: 印度 GST 号码验证

map.印度 GST 号码验证器。输入 15 位商品与服务税号，校验结构与校验位，用于印: India GST number validator. Enter the 15-digit Goods and Services Tax number; validate structure and check digit, for tax-number format checks in Indian tax and business scenarios (not a validity check).
map.GSTIN 校验：前 14 位按加权求和 mod 36，末位为 Base36 校: GSTIN check: first 14 digits weighted-sum mod 36, the last is a Base36 check character
map.依据印度 GST 规则校验 15 位税号的州码、PAN 部分与末位校验字符；仅校: Per India's GST rules, validate the 15-digit number's state code, PAN part and last check character; format check only, not registration authenticity.
map.校验印度 GSTIN 格式与结构: Validate the Indian GSTIN format and structure
map.GSTIN 为 15 位：前 2 位州码、接着 10 位 PAN、第 13 位实: GSTIN is 15 digits: first 2 state code, then 10 PAN, digit 13 entity sequence, digit 14 default Z, last 1 check character (MOD-36 over the first 14). Both format and check digit must be right for a legal structure.
map.通过结构校验仅说明符合编码规则，不代表该税号真实注册；实际以税务门户查询为准。: Passing structural validation only means it fits the encoding rules, not that the number is really registered; the tax portal is authoritative.
map.确认 15 位结构、PAN 嵌入与末位校验字符正确，拦截录入错误；是否真实有效需: It confirms the 15-digit structure, PAN embedding and last check character are correct, intercepting entry errors; real validity needs official check.
map.标准预留位（默认 Z），用于未来扩展；当前所有 GSTIN 第 14 位固定为: the standard reserved digit (default Z), for future extension; currently all GSTINs fix digit 14 as Z.
